Ah, I can feel something!
The cherry tree... those two are speaking to me!
What is it you want to say?
What are you trying to tell me?
...Oh, is that so? Really?
I understand...
It seems those two have chosen you to take over after me.
I can tell...
Those two seem pleased about it, too.
About the birth of a new servant...
If you don't believe it, that's fine. You'll just end up the sacrifice yourself, that's all.
And you'll see that dream every night, too.
And those two's faces of terror, as well.
Don't worry, you'll get used to it soon.
Oh, and there was a promise you made me earlier, remember?
Thank you for keeping it.
Keeping that promise was one of the conditions for being chosen, you see.{p}
